Basically the title, I'm not sure how to go about this, For example we are very early in the campaign and these 2 players, after killing the first boss, took all of the loot and sold it and split it 50/50 leaving the other players in the party with nothing. When the other 2 players and I were upset about this and saying we should have some way of realizing what is happening and have something to do about it we were accused of "meta gaming" and were told there was nothing we could do. When we got to the second boss these 2 players tried to do the same thing and the other 3 said no way. So now no one knows what to do and characters are grappling, fighting and pick-pocketing to get this loot. The DM just kind of finds it funny and won't do anything about it. What can I say to him or the other players to fix this? These 2 players have well over 1000 Gold Coins and the other 3 have essentially nothing, and any loot we would earn as a group is taken and sold. What can I say to the DM or the other players to fix this?
2 other players in my campaign are taking loot and selling it and not sharing the money with the party. The DM won't even allow the other 3 players to do anything, what can I do?

I've had things like this happen to me in games but never this bad. I don't think most DM would put up with things that distract from the cooperation of the players. Your characters should at least be able to roll insight to see if they are scamming you. You and the other 2 guys might try to find a new group. If you can't do that you might try nipping his bag while on long rest and dumping it out in font of the rest of the party. Or maybe if your character is strong enough pick his up by the ankles and shake everything out of him looney toons style.

Make it clear if your character is scounging for scraps, he would look for another adventuring party, and take his fellow poor men with him. Effectively putting in the other players court on how they need to fix it. Unless you are in a railroaded game, this should easily work. Of course the one time you do catch them stealing, go hammurabi and chop off his hands in his sleep.

Although this is a very good in-game solution, this is more of an OOC problem — in a team game, people are deliberately working against the team. The only solution is to talk to the players. If they're not willing to compromise, and you're not willing to deal with their playstyle, I'd flip them off and bail.

DM finds it funny

Tell him that while it might be a joke to him, to you it's your character being completely shafted and the exact sort of thing a DM should put a stop to after it stops being funny. Like, getting screwed over once can actually be quite funny in the right context, but if it's a consistent problem then it's the DM's job to set it right.

In game solution, stop adventuring with those two. You are doing hard work for little pay, it makes sense to start looking for a better party to be adventuring with.

Out of game solution, if the DM won't do anything about it leave the game. Start your own.

A game session is supposed to be fun. If those three people are making it stop being fun for you, then leave them to their game while you go forth in search of better entertainment.

While playing with my dear friend Omi, I came across a glitch using the pop machines and the hazmat suits. This little glitch allows players to wear the hoods with hazmat suits with any mask or gear item other than the default gas mask. This is currently known to work on PS4, PC and Xbox 1. Old gen consoles are untested at this time.

Steps to recreate:

  1. Equip any colored hazmat suit from the clothing store.
  2. Find a pop machine. (We used the one located in the gun stores with the shooting range.)
  3. Equip any mask you want to use with the suit. This will NOT work with hats (at least to our knowledge)
  4. Buy a drink from the pop machine and just wait. You should see that after you're done drinking the soda that your mask is now on as well as the hood of the hazmat suit.

Images:

Fox mask

Charcoal Tight Ski Mask

Black Combat Mask

Night Vision

Thats it! Here is a video tutorial showing the glitch in action. I know the pop machine method is well known but I havent seen a post about the hazmat suits. We used the animal masks in the video but you can use any mask you want.

NOTE: Some masks that show your hair will clip through the top of the hazmat suit hood. You can kinda see it with Omi wearing the white hazmat with the white hair.
